warnings: Lower half of S-05: the two embedded truss-anchor plates and the purlin lap, each drawn at 1:10. 'Plateเหล็ก 1' is embedded in the top of RB2 under T2 (S-04 plan: at 2.40 / 4.50 / 6.60 on grids 1 and 9 — grid dummies A'''' / A'''''' / B'; S-06 T2: 'Plateเหล็ก 1 (ดูขยาย) เชื่อมตลอดแนวสัมผัส T2'); 'Plateเหล็ก 2' sits on a column head 0.35 x 0.45 (S-04 plan: 'Plate เหล็ก 2 หัวเสา (ดูขยาย)'). element_id = the printed detail mark 'Plateเหล็ก N' (§0.3), same convention as house 125's 'แบบขยาย N'.

Both plates print the same parts: Plate 6 มม 0.25x0.25 ม + 2U-DB 12 mm welded along the contact line, embedded ≥ 0.25. They are kept as two elements because they are two different printed marks at two different supports (RB2 beam top vs column head), not merged.
'ระยะทาบแปเหล็กโครงหลังคา' prints the lap as '2เท่าของ D' with D the purlin depth; lap_length_mm 200 = 2 x 100 is arithmetic on the printed section, flagged lap_length_derived_2xD.

All dimensions on this view (0.25 plate, ≥ 0.25 embedment, 0.35 / 0.45 column head) are element-internal (§4 rule 4) and stay on the elements; none runs along a grid axis. Extracted in the 2026-10-22 resume run.
